description: Methodology change: switched from market-based to location-based for two DCs. Not clearly disclosed in last year report. Requires reconciliation and restatement.
Boundary change: DC5 sold to third party in Q2 2026. Emissions for first 6 months of FY26 now excluded from scope. Material impact on year-on-year comparison.
Data quality issue: three months of utility bills from DC1 show 20% spike. Utility company investigating meter malfunction. Restatement pending.
Verification issue: LED retrofit project at 8 stores completed in July. Energy reduction claims not yet verified by external auditor. Documentation incomplete.
Emissions factor update: UK grid carbon intensity dropped 12% in FY26. Factor change not applied to H2 calculations. Requires restatement.
